subject: gk
question: Which of the following Trophies/Cups is related to cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Duleep Trophy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Duleep Trophy is a cricket trophy**
 
• **It was **Introduced in **1961-62** by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• **Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji**, a legendary Indian cricketer who played for England.
 
• Initially contested by geographical zones of India (e.g., North Zone, South Zone).
 
• Later, it evolved into teams representing **India Red, India Blue, and India Green**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **some other trophies associated with different sports:**
 
• **Hockey:** Murugappa Gold Cup, Beighton Cup, Nehru Trophy, Stanley Cup, Agha Khan Cup, Dhyanchand Trophy 
 
• **Football:** Durand Cup, Rovers Cup, Santosh Trophy, Begum Hazrat Mahal Trophy, Nehru Cup 
 
• **Badminton**: Thomas Cup, Uber Cup, European Cup, Malaysian Cup, Harilela Cup 
 
• **Tennis:** Davis Cup, Wimbledon Trophy 
 
• **Golf:** Ryder Cup, Walker Cup, Canada Cup, Eisenhower Cup
